conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I’m worried! My savings account shows a withdrawal I didn’t make. Is someone stealing my money?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: That’s alarming Sir. Can you confirm the transaction amount and date to investigate?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s ₹25,000, from yesterday. I never authorized this!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you. I’ve frozen your account to prevent further issues and will file a fraud report.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please make sure my money’s safe. I’m really scared about this.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Your account is secure now Sir. We’ll reverse the transaction within 5-7 days and keep you updated.
